title: Cloud providers
subtitle: Connect the model providers that run on someone else's hardware.

browser.label: Cloud catalog
browser.moreModels: Showing {{shown}} of {{count}}. Refine the search to see the rest.
browser.modelConnect: Connect the selected provider below to use this model.
browser.modelReady: This provider is connected: choose the model in the model picker to start a chat.

guide.label: Cloud provider setup
guide.chooseTitle: Bring cloud models into your workspace
guide.chooseDescription: Use hosted models without downloading them or using your device’s memory. Connect one provider to get started, then add as many as you like.
guide.connectDescription: Use your provider’s API key or sign in below. Your provider account handles model access and billing.
guide.browseHint: You can also browse models before connecting.
guide.successHint: Choose its models in the workspace composer to start a chat.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: OpenAI, Anthropic, or a compatible endpoint.
connection.routing: Requests reach this provider through the local API server at {{baseUrl}}, so every client configured against that address can use these models too.
connection.keyless: This endpoint runs on your machine and needs no API key.
connection.disconnectDescription: The saved API key is deleted and this provider's models leave the model picker. Reconnect by entering the key again.
connection.empty: No cloud providers available. Refresh the catalog and try again.
connection.placeholder: Pick a connection above to set it up.
connection.mediaNoModels: {{provider}} answered but lists no models. Start it with a model and try again.
connection.keyRejected: {{provider}} did not accept this API key.
connection.ownServer: This address is Atomic Chat's own Local API Server ({{url}}). Enter the address of the provider you want to reach.
connection.unverifiedHint: The key is saved, but {{provider}} could not be asked whether it works.
connection.rejectedHint: {{provider}} refused this key. Enter a valid key, or check again.

subscription.title: ChatGPT subscription (Codex)
subscription.description: Authorize in your system browser. Tokens never enter browser storage.
subscription.browserHint: Finish signing in to ChatGPT in your browser, then come back.
